verdict.rationale: Letta's memory is stored as Markdown files in a memory repository and shared memory is backed by Git repositories (letta-docs-11, letta-docs-21, letta-docs-66), and self-hosted/local mode keeps all agent state on-device without a cloud account (letta-docs-30, letta-docs-74), which implies memory is not locked behind a proprietary opaque format. However, no evidence documents an explicit 'export' command, API endpoint, or file-format spec for extracting memories out of Letta into another system. missing for 10: explicit export/import command or API, documented portable file schema, and independent confirmation that exported memory can be reused outside Letta.
